question: How long do I have to return an item?

candidate_a.text: You can request a refund within 30 days of delivery, as long as the item is unused and still in its original packaging.
candidate_a.author: assistant-v2

candidate_b.text: Refunds are generally available for a while after purchase. Contact support and they will let you know if you still qualify.
candidate_b.author: assistant-v1

question: How fast is standard shipping and when is it free?

candidate_a.text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free over $50 per order.
candidate_a.author: assistant-v2

candidate_b.text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express and next-day options are also available at checkout.
candidate_b.author: assistant-v1

question: My password reset link stopped working. Why?

candidate_a.text: The reset link expires 15 minutes after it is sent. Request a new one from the sign-in page and use it right away.
candidate_a.author: assistant-v2

candidate_b.text: Account security is something we take extremely seriously, and there are a number of reasons why you might be running into trouble signing in to your account today. We generally recommend that customers use a reputable password manager, enable two-factor authentication on every service they rely on, and choose a long passphrase rather than a short complicated password. If you continue to experience difficulty, our support team is available to help you regain safe access to your account at any time.
candidate_b.author: assistant-v1

question: When can I reach a human?

candidate_a.text: Live support is staffed during business hours, 9am to 6pm Eastern, Monday through Friday.
candidate_a.author: assistant-v2

candidate_b.text: We answer during business hours: 9am to 6pm ET on weekdays.
candidate_b.author: assistant-v1

question: How do I track my package?

candidate_a.text: Send us your order id and we will look up the tracking number for you.
candidate_a.author: assistant-v2

candidate_b.text: Open the confirmation email, copy the order id at the top, and paste it into the tracking page to see the tracking number and current status.
candidate_b.author: assistant-v1

question: What does the warranty actually cover?

candidate_b.text: The warranty runs for two years from purchase and covers manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, liquid damage, and normal wear are not covered.
candidate_b.author: assistant-v1
